prompt: In the Splice project {project}, zoom in to 2x from second 2 to second 6 of the recording, with the zoom following the mouse cursor as it moves. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: a zoom following the cursor
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'zoom' and i['params'].get('focus') == 'cursor' for i in items)

checks.name: about 2x
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'zoom' and abs(i['params'].get('amount', 0) - 2) < 0.15 for i in items)

checks.name: about 2-6 s
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'zoom' and 3.4 <= seconds(i['length']) <= 4.6 for i in items)
